_comment: Template for kms_schema.json — the source of truth for what is queryable, since the getData API has no discovery endpoint. Generate the real file from your live tenant with `uv run python scripts/build_schema.py`, or copy this template and edit. Tag filtering uses findQuery on tags.<collection>.data.<filter_field>; `values` maps a human display name to that field's id (a tagId slug for most collections, or _id for slug-less ones like nooraUsers). `content_types` on each tag_type lists which content types actually carry that collection. Values below are illustrative.

tag_types.name: Noora User
tag_types.description: Staff who authored/are referenced. Slug-less, so filtered by _id.
